summary: Frontend testing of Phase F2.1 Product Gallery™ + Curated References™ + Moodboard Picker on /inspirations/products/8be6c3b4-bd3c-45a6-8ece-8051924af599. 12/13 flows PASS visually and functionally. One CRITICAL crash in MoodboardPickerModal blocks the moodboard add flow and produces a full-screen React error overlay.

minor.issue: Returns {data: [...]} envelope while frontend MoodboardPickerModal expects {items: [...]} or a raw array. API contract mismatch — backend can either also expose 'items' alias or frontend must handle 'data' key. Caller crashes.

ui_bugs.issue: Crashes with TypeError: filtered.map is not a function (and earlier moodboards.filter on a non-array). Root cause: line 36 setMoodboards(r.data?.items || r.data || []) — when API returns {data:[...]}, r.data.items is undefined, fallback r.data is the object {data:[...]}, not array. .filter() on object → TypeError. The error overlay then unmounts the entire page UI. FIX: setMoodboards(r.data?.items || r.data?.data || (Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : []))

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix MoodboardPickerModal.jsx line 36 — handle {data:[...]} envelope from /api/moodboards. Suggested patch: const list = r.data?.items ?? r.data?.data ?? (Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : []); setMoodboards(list); This will unblock pg-hero-moodboard flow and prevent the React error overlay from killing the page.
Optional: backend can also alias 'items' on /api/moodboards response for consistency with collections endpoint (which returns {items:[...]}).
critical_code_review_comments: MoodboardPickerModal.jsx:36 — defensive parsing of paginated API responses is missing; the OR fallback r.data?.items || r.data silently passes through non-array shapes and explodes downstream in .filter/.map. Always guard with Array.isArray before useMemo filter chains.

ProductGalleryPage.jsx — no <ErrorBoundary> wrapping MoodboardPickerModal / CuratedCollectionDrawer; a single uncaught error tears down the entire 3-col immersive view. Recommend wrapping modals in an ErrorBoundary so the parent gallery survives child crashes.
Inconsistent API envelope across modules: /api/moodboards uses {data:[...]} while /api/inspirations/references/collections uses {items:[...]}. Pick one and document it.

ProductGalleryPage.jsx (~695 lines, single file) is approaching the 700-line maintainability threshold — extract Bucket, AssetTile, AssetBadges, AssetInfoTab, ReferencesTab, RelatedTab, FloatingTray into small files under /pages/inspirations/product-gallery/.

rca_of_the_issue: API /api/moodboards?limit=40 returns {data: [...]}. Frontend code does setMoodboards(r.data?.items || r.data || []) → because r.data.items is undefined and r.data is truthy (it's the response body object), moodboards state becomes the literal response object {data:[...]}. Then in useMemo: moodboards.filter(...) on an object throws TypeError, AND/OR filtered.map(...) on the result throws. CRA error overlay then replaces the rendered tree, which is why italian copy and tabs become 'missing' in DOM after the crash. Reproduction: login → /inspirations/products/8be6c3b4-bd3c-45a6-8ece-8051924af599 → click [data-testid=pg-hero-moodboard] → red overlay 'filtered.map is not a function at MoodboardPickerModal'. Mitigation: normalize response in MoodboardPickerModal useEffect to always assign an array.
